units: <cite ref="Chullin 65a:6">Ḥull. 65ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>אצל ע׳</he>, v. <cite ref="G00692"><he>זַרְזִיר</he> II</cite>.
Ib. 63ᵃ ע׳ אוכמא the black ‘oreb (raven); ע׳ העמקי חיוורא the ‘oreb of the valley, the white spotted ‘oreb; ע׳ הבא בראשי יונים the ‘oreb (crow) that moves in advance of the doves.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 108b:12">Snh. 108ᵇ</cite> <he>תשובה … ע׳ לנח</he> the raven brought a convincing argument against Noah; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 58:2">Yalk. Gen. 58</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 58:2">ib.</cite> <he>ע׳ רק</he> the raven was punished inasmuch as he spits (semen from his mouth, Rashi).
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 23">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXIII</cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6">Tosef. Sabb. VI (VII), 6</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 67b">Sabb. 67ᵇ</cite> (v. <cite ref="P00352"><he>עוֹרַבְתָּא</he></cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="P00351"><he>עוֹרְבִים</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Chullin 5a:4">Ḥull. 5ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="I Kings 17:6">I Kings XVII, 6</cite>) <he>ע׳ ממש</he> ravens in the true sense; <he>דילמא … שמייהו ע׳</he> might it not mean two men by the family name of ‘Oreb (as <cite ref="Judges 7:25">Jud. VII, 25</cite>); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33:5">Gen. R. s. 33</cite>; a. fr.
